RECOMMENDED DATABASE TABLES ## positions `position_id, original_title, normalized_title, organization, programme_name, role_family, seniority_level` ## competencies `competency_id, framework, competency_type, competency, sub_competency` ## position_competency_mapping `position_id, competency_id, required_level, mapping_source` ## igot_courses `course_id, course_name, provider, duration, source_programme_id` ## course_skills `course_id, skill_id, skill_name, skill_type, source_or_inferred` ## course_modules `course_id, module_id, module_name, source_or_synthetic` ## learning_items `module_id, item_id, item_name, source_or_synthetic` ## employee_competency_scores `employee_id, competency_id, current_score, assessment_date` ## recommendations `employee_id, course_id, relevance_score, reason, rank` # 10. PERSONALIZED RECOMMENDATION LOGIC A prototype recommendation score can combine:
Competency relevance: How directly the course supports the employee's missing competency.
Role relevance: How frequently the course is associated with the employee's role or role family.
Skill relevance: Semantic similarity between the employee's skill gap and course topics.
Difficulty: Match between learner level and course difficulty.
Previous learning: Avoid recommending already completed courses unless refresher learning is appropriate.

Assessment performance: Prior quiz/assessment results can increase the weight of weak topics. Example: ``` text Employee Role: Map Analyst Required Competency: Behavioural → Communication → Presentation Skills Current Score: 42/100 Gap: 58 points Candidate learning: 1. Report Writing Skills for Projects 2. Interpersonal Skills in the Workplace 3. Microsoft PowerPoint Advanced Ranking considers competency relevance + skill similarity + previous learning + difficulty. ``` # 11. AI

GENERATED ASSESSMENT LAYER The SIH platform can use uploaded learning material to generate assessment questions. The content layer should be separated from the competency layer. ``` text Course ↓ Module ↓ Learning Item / PDF / Video / Presentation ↓ NLP / LLM Extraction ↓ Concepts + Learning Objectives ↓ MCQ / Quiz Generation ↓ Answer + Explanation ↓ Topic
wise Score ↓ Competency Score Update ``` # 12. DATA QUALITY RULES
Never convert every iGOT tag into an official competency.
Keep provider/organization because the same broad designation can have different learning requirements.
Keep separate records when the same broad role has different competency mappings.
Treat one course as potentially reusable across multiple roles.
Treat one role as potentially requiring multiple competencies and courses.
Mark synthetic module/item metadata as synthetic.
Verify live iGOT metadata before using generated modules/items as official source data.
Preserve original programme titles in a source

title field even when a normalized title is used for the UI. # 13. FINAL SIH REPRESENTATION ``` text EMPLOYEE ↓ PROFILE BUILDER ├── Designation ├── Department ├── Current Assignment ├── Education ├── Experience └── Previous Training ↓ COMPETENCY PROFILE ↓ REQUIRED COMPETENCY GRAPH ↓ CURRENT SCORE vs REQUIRED SCORE ↓ SKILL / COMPETENCY GAP ↓ iGOT COURSE RETRIEVAL ↓ SEMANTIC + COMPETENCY RANKING ↓ PERSONALIZED LEARNING PATH ↓ COURSE / MODULE / CONTENT ↓ AI
GENERATED QUIZ / MCQ ↓ ASSESSMENT RESULT ↓ UPDATED COMPETENCY PROFILE ``` # 14. END NOTE This 40
role dataset is a prototype knowledge base designed to demonstrate the SIH competency

learning workflow. Its strongest architectural feature is the separation of official competency mappings, course/skill metadata, and content/module metadata. This makes it possible to recommend learning without incorrectly treating every course topic as an official competency.
